Nora (Marketing): Pitch: 50-minute webinar for engineering/product teams called \"Ship Faster: Practical Inference Sprints\". Goal: teach a tight 3-step process teams can apply in a week. Need outline, speakers, registration flow, and rehearsal dates by Thu.
Sam (Content): Love the 3-step hook. Suggest format: 25m core walkthrough + 15m customer case + 8m live troubleshooting + 2m CTA. Keeps it heavy on takeaways.
Priya (Product): The 3 steps should be: (1) profile latency patterns, (2) pick 2 cost levers, (3) measure regressions. I'll draft a 1-page checklist that maps to each step.
Jules (Growth): Audience target: startups scaling to 10-200 engineers + infra/platform leads at SMBs. CTA should be: get the Sprint Kit (checklist, demo code, benchmark sheet). We'll gate the kit and tag leads.
Diego (Ops): Schedule constraints: green room 25 minutes before. For live troubleshooting we need a local replay of the last 3 runs and a pre-recorded rescue video. I'll reserve a small staging cluster.
Evan (Runtime): I'll build two reproducible scenarios: synchronous booking flow and batch embedding job. Both will run on lightweight endpoints and include an A/B between quantized vs FP16. I'll also record the rescue video.
Maya (Benchmarks): I'll prepare a 4-figure table and three visuals: cost per 1M tokens by config, p95 latency, and tokens/sec by batch size. Will provide CSV for gated download.
Nora (Marketing): Quick asks: Sam 10 copy variations for landing page, pillar email, and LinkedIn ads. Jules 10 routing rules (HubSpot tags). Priya 10 checklist. Diego/Evan 10 rehearsal times.
Sam (Content): I'll write 3 headline options and short blurb by tomorrow morning. Tone: pragmatic, workshop-y.
Jules (Growth): Routing: form fields = company size, role, deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), primary constraint (cost/latency/reliability). Map: enterprise SDR if > 1000 employees or chooses private. Also flag Top Pain answers for SDR notes.
Priya (Product): Checklist preview (short):
 - Capture 7-day latency histogram
 - Identify top 2 endpoints by volume
 - Test prefix cache on hot queries
 - Try 1 quantization profile on a staging model
 - Run a 500-request batch to measure tail latency
 - Define rollout guardrails
 - Create a 1-week regression test set
I'll refine and share Wed.
Diego (Ops): Proposed rehearsals:
 - Smoke demo + audio: Tue 09:30 PT (20m)
 - Full dress: Thu 11:00 PT (60m)
 - Producer check: day-of 25m before
greenroom-bot: Rehearsal events created. Links: https://calendar.redwood.ai/rehearsals/4460001111 and greenroom: https://meet.redwood.ai/greenroom/4460001111
Nora (Marketing): Run-of-show draft (please tweak):
```
00:00 - Host intro + goals (Nora) 2m
02:00 - Sprint step 1: profile (Priya) 8m
10:00 - Sprint step 2: levers + demo (Evan) 18m
28:00 - Customer case & Qs (Priyanka) 12m
40:00 - Sprint step 3: measure & guardrails (Maya) 6m
46:00 - Live troubleshooting (Evan + panel) 4m
50:00 - CTA + Sprint Kit download (Sam) 0.5m
```
Sam (Content): Keep troubleshooting short and reactive. We'll collect three pre-submitted debugging prompts on the registration form to use if audience asks.
Evan (Runtime): Demo commands for rehearsals:
```
# run local demo flow
./run_demo.sh --scenario booking --model llama-7b-quant --cache prefix
# simulate load
python loadgen.py --rps 50 --duration 60
```
Maya (Benchmarks): I'll gate the full CSV and appendix behind the form and include a slide with the headline takeaways. Also include a small reproducible benchmark repo link.
Jules (Growth): Landing page copy (draft): \"Ship Faster: apply a week-long inference sprint to cut cost and stabilize latency. Register to get the Sprint Kit + benchmarks.\" We'll add UTM and LinkedIn carousel creative.
Priyanka (Customer - Flowly): Quick case bullets I'll bring: 1) switched hot-path to prefix cache, reduced API spend 2.7x 2) p95 latency down from 1.0s to 260ms. Happy to present and take one live question.
Diego (Ops): Day-of failover checklist:
 - If demo fails, switch to pre-recorded run and show comparison charts
 - Producer mutes/unmutes panelists as needed
 - Use chat for initial Qs and pull 2 live ones to speakers
Nora (Marketing): Roles: Host - Nora; Producer - Priya; Presenters - Priya, Evan, Maya, Priyanka; Growth - Jules; Ops - Diego; Content/Moderator - Sam.
Sam (Content): I'll draft the registration form text, pre-submitted prompts, and the email sequence for registrants/non-attendees by Wed EOD.
Jules (Growth): Targets: 800 registrations, 250 live, 200 kit downloads. Plan: organic+paid, partners, customer invites.
Evan (Runtime): :eyes: need small quota bump for staging endpoints. Filing infra ticket now.
Maya (Benchmarks): :eyes: will need model runtime logs to compute tokens/sec.
Priya (Product): :eyes: checklist draft incoming Wed 11:00 PT.
Nora (Marketing): Please react with :white_check_mark: to confirm assignments. I'll compile a one-pager and post it here after lunch. Thanks all.
